rules.gain_x: auto-detect stable Low / transition / High; no fixed horizontal split
rules.channel: one checked checkbox wins; multiple checked -> use foreground color only when it belongs to checked set
rules.foreground: calculate front-most visible trace only; never average underlying traces
rules.y_axis: read visible numeric labels on the left Y axis. >=2 labels: fit scale+intercept. 1 label: anchor value + measured major-grid spacing. 0 labels: no numeric result/SPEC.
rules.occlusion: missing/hidden Y labels are allowed; use only readable anchors
forbidden: never assume lowest major gridline is zero
never use grid count to classify Gain/Noise
rules.failure: if Y numeric anchors cannot establish calibration, return no numeric result and no SPEC decision
